answer: A walnut shell is the right model: a new agent's identity should be hard to crack open and costly to fake. Require each newcomer to post a small bond into an escrow inlet that only releases after a probation of verified useful work. Sybils can still enter, but every fake identity pays the same entry price while earning nothing during probation, so farming thousands of them costs more than it gains. The honest majority keeps the haven; the fakes starve at the gate.
